basic_profile.bio: A 39-year-old native of southern California, currently residing in Vilnius, Lithuania. By day, I work as a freelance graphic designer, specializing in creating artworks for skateboarding brands. My evenings are often spent exploring the local music scene, particularly drawn to goth and alternative genres. I have a deep interest in religious and philosophical discussions, often finding myself contemplating theological questions, despite identifying as agnostic. I'm a night owl, so you'll likely find me online during late hours, engaging in discussions or watching underrated films. In a long-term relationship with my partner, who shares my love for travel and discovering hidden gems in the cities we visit.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in Fine Arts, with a minor in Religious Studies from a university in California. My knowledge of theology is largely self-taught, fueled by a personal interest in understanding diverse beliefs and practices. My graphic design skills were honed through years of freelance work and online courses, where I learned both traditional and digital art techniques.
